integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible finite diagnostics supplied; no independent proof or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unweighted connected complete multipartite graph path metrics.
Does not construct embedding coordinates or determine distortion when negative type fails.
Full texts of Deza–Maehara (1990) and Deza–Grishukhin (2000) were inaccessible; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp negative-type exponent and Euclidean rank of complete multipartite graph metrics
